DOCS #71–#80 · NAVAL INSTITUTE PRESS

CCP Espionage & Surveillance (1927–2019), Rear Adm. McDevitt's 21st-Century Naval Power & Barton Whaley's Deception Methodology

Ten foundational Naval Institute Press chapters (118 PDF pages, 577 endnotes, 40 audited rows [38 ok, 2 fix], 8 shared source clusters, 6 synthesis memos).

Cluster A · Docs #71–#73 (CCE) 2019 · 36 pp. · 253 notes

Mattis & Brazil: CCP Intelligence Orgs, Espionage Cases & Domestic Surveillance

Audits 3 chapters (CCE-C1, CCE-C6, CCE-C7): evolution from 1927 Teke, PPB, SAD, and CID to 2PLA/JSD/SSF and the 18-bureau MSS; cyber-HUMINT fusion (OPM/Taiwan database hacks + JSSD/Xu Yanjun aviation ring); 34 U.S./Taiwan/European espionage case entries; and PRC 'baseline surveillance' (shenfen zheng, hukou, dang'an, Alibaba Zhima Credit, and 6 intensive MPS/MSS methods).

Audit Catch (CCEC6-R02 · fix): Caught p. 5 calling James Fondren Col. James Fondren, USA (Ret.) while p. 7 calls him a retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel (plus MMS typo for MSS in CCE-C7).
Cluster B · Docs #74–#79 (CN21) 2020 · 77 pp. · 320 notes

Rear Adm. McDevitt: China As a Twenty-First Century Naval Power (6 Chapters)

Audits 6 chapters (CN21-C1 to C5, C8): Hu/Xi maritime great-power timelines & 'SLOC anxiety'; 1985–2008 voyages (Tables 1–2) & 12 years of Gulf of Aden escorts (33 rotations, 27,000 sailors, Djibouti base); 131 blue-water ships built since 2004 & Table 3 global comparison; sequenced Taiwan campaign (Tables 4–6, RAND airbase TBM math, 56-sub wolf-pack shortfall, July 2019 6-missile DF-21D test); Xi's 'Five Cannots'; and the 2035 425-ship PLAN forecast.

Audit Catch (CN21C1-R01 · fix): Caught p. 9 misdating Xi's Oct 2017 19th Party Congress report to October 2018 (contradicting pp. 1 & 5). Verified 100% of Tables 1–6.
Cluster C · Doc #80 (PTD-P1) 2016 · 5 pp. · Chs. 1–3

Barton Whaley: Practise to Deceive Part One (Intent, Scope & Sources)

Completes our 5-part audit of Whaley's magnum opus (PTD-P1 joining PTD-00, PTD-C6, PTD-C7, PTD-P3): documents the July 6, 1987 RAND proposal to Feer & Whelan (57 cases for Fort Irwin OPFOR exercises, expanded to 88 cases), the 3 computerized databases (DECEPTR 230 cases & NTC 140 cases), the CIA Library Whaley Collection, and debunking myths about Eisenhower, Mark Clark & Montgomery.

Audit Verification (4/4 ok): Verified the 57+31=88 case math, DECEPTR/NTC database structure, and Col. Meinertzhagen fabricated-memoir critique.
